summary: Sigma Lithium Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 5, 2026, announcing that it will release second quarter 2026 earnings results on August 14, 2026, and noting that it exceeded its 1H 2026 production target by 6%, delivering 35,000 tonnes of lithium concentrate in Q2. The filing is a routine earnings release notification and production update — not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The registrant acts solely as the filer of its own operational update. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or advisors to analyze. Watch for the actual earnings release and any forward-looking guidance on expansion phases.
